title: LightningPrfmEventLog - Data API
description: Lightning Performance events track trends in Lightning Experience and Salesforce mobile app performance. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

AppName.description: The name of the application that the user accessed.

BrowserName.description: The name of the browser that the user accessed.

BrowserVersion.description: The version of the browser that the user accessed in major.minor version format. Some browsers don’t provide a minor version.

ClientGeolocation.description: The geolocation of the client in the form of <Country>/<State|Province>.

ClientIp.description: The IP address of the client that’s using Salesforce services. A Salesforce internal IP (such as a login from AppExchange) is shown as “Salesforce.com IP”. For example: 96.43.144.26.

ConnectionType.possible_values: CDMA1x CDMA EDGE EVDO0 EVDOA EVDOB GPRS HRPD HSDPA HSUPA LTE WIFI

DeviceIdentifier.description: The unique identifier used to identify a device when tracking events. DEVICE_ID is a generated value that’s created when the mobile app is initially run after installation.

DeviceModel.description: The name of the device model.

DevicePlatform.description: The type of application experience in name:experience:form format.
DevicePlatform.possible_values: name: APP_BUILDER, CUSTOM, S1, SFX experience: BROWSER, HYBRID form: DESKTOP, PHONE, TABLET

DeviceSessionIdentifier.description: The unique identifier of the user’s session based on page load time. When the user reloads a page, a new session is started.

Duration.description: The duration in milliseconds since the page start time.

LoginKey.description: The string that ties together all events in a user’s login session. It starts with a login event and ends with either a logout event or the user session expiring.

MobileSdkVersion.description: The mobile SDK application version number.

OperatingSystemName.description: The operating system name, derived from USER_AGENT.

OperatingSystemVersion.description: The operating system version, derived from USER_AGENT.

PageStartTime.description: The time when the page was initially loaded, measured in milliseconds.

PageUrl.description: Relative URL of the top-level Lightning Experience or Salesforce mobile app page that the user opened. The page can contain one or more Lightning components.

PreviousPageUrl.description: The relative URL of the previous Lightning Experience or Salesforce mobile app page that the user opened.

RequestIdentifier.description: The unique ID of a single transaction. A transaction can contain one or more events. Each event in a given transaction has the same REQUEST_ID.

SessionKey.description: The hash of the session ID to allow tracking of all events in a session.

Timestamp.description: The access time of Salesforce services in GMT.

UiEventIdentifier.description: Id of the Lightning event type.

UiEventSource.description: The source of the performance event.

UserIdentifier.description: The 15-character ID of the user who’s using Salesforce services through the UI or the API. For example: 00530000009M943

UserType.description: The category of user license of the user accessing Salesforce services through the UI or API.

special_access_rules: To access this object, you must have the View Event Log Object Data user permission.
